basic_info.description: The last 3-bedroom A-corner home, Residence 64A, redefines luxury living with impeccable design and breathtaking views from Golden Gate to the Bay Bridge. This residence features 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and 1,841 sq. ft. of meticulously curated space for $4,495,000. Soaring bay and skyline vistas frame the open living and dining area, while French oak floors lead to a gourmet kitchen outfitted with Miele and Sub-Zero appliances. The primary bath, clad in Arabescato Corchia marble, offers a serene retreat. With furnishings curated by ODADA, this home exudes sophistication, with bespoke touches like Lutron solar shades throughout. The option for a turnkey furnished residence ensures effortless luxury. Beyond your private sanctuary, 181 Fremont spoils you with a suite of elite amenities: 5-star services, an exclusive full-floor Residents' Club with stylish lounges, a fireside retreat, and a 360-degree open-air terrace. Fitness enthusiasts will enjoy the state-of-the-art gym and yoga studio, while art lovers admire the curated collection gracing the common areas. As the only residential building with direct access to Salesforce Park, your 5.4-acre urban oasis awaits. *Photography/video from a similar unit on a lower floor.
